description:
Mini USB rechargeable LED flashlight with XPE torch and COB work light gives you a bright, pocket-ready beam for power cuts, night walks, and quick repairs. Use the XPE front light for a focused throw when you need distance, then switch to the side COB light for wide, even illumination that lights up a room, tent, or engine bay. With 3 modes (High, Strobe, Side COB), you can go from everyday lighting to attention-grabbing emergency use in seconds.

Built in a tough aluminum alloy body, it’s splash‑resistant for light rain and damp conditions. The pen clip and hanging rope make it easy to carry on a pocket, belt, backpack strap, or key hook—so it’s always within reach. Recharge by USB to skip disposable batteries and keep a reliable light ready for travel, camping, cycling, and home emergencies.

3 practical modes: High beam for daily use, Strobe for emergency signaling, and Side COB for close-up work and campsite lighting.
USB rechargeable convenience: Built-in rechargeable battery charges by USB, reducing ongoing battery costs and keeping your torch ready anytime.
Pocket-ready mini size: Compact body fits easily in jeans, tool bags, and glove boxes—ideal as an everyday carry flashlight.
Splash-resistant build: Handles light rain and splashes, making it suitable for outdoor walks, cycling, and roadside use.
Hands-free carry options: Strong pen clip and hanging rope let you clip it to pockets/bags or hang it in a tent or on a hook.
Durable aluminum alloy body: Tough, impact-resistant feel for daily handling and travel.
